title: Hirsutine attenuates renal injury in diabetic kidney disease by regulating Th17 cell differentiation via the TGFbeta/SMAD Pathway.
authors: Pei, Zhenzhen; Zhang, Yang; Wen, Zhige; Chen, Yupeng; Zhang, Shan; Ni, Qing; Ni, Boran
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Hirsutine通过TGFbeta/SMAD通路调节Th17细胞分化改善糖尿病肾病，属于纯疾病药理与湿实验研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hirsutine (HS), a bioactive indole alkaloid isolated from Uncaria rhynchophylla, a traditional Chinese herb, has long been used in the treatment of hypertension and inflammatory disorders. However, its nephroprotective potential in diabetic kidney disease (DKD),-a primary cause of end-stage renal failure, remains insufficiently studied, particularly regarding its immunomodulatory mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: High-throughput RNA sequencing was performed on renal tissues to identify differentially expressed genes (DEGs). Network pharmacology was employed to uncover potential HS targets and associated pathways relevant to DKD, while molecular docking predicted protein interactions. In vivo validation was conducted using db/db mice treated with HS, with evaluations of renal function, histopathology, Th17 cell differentiation, and the TGFbeta/SMAD signaling pathway. RESULTS: Transcriptome analysis identified 837 DEGs. Enrichment analysis of these DEGs and network pharmacology revealed that TGFbeta signaling-mediated Th17 cell differentiation could be a critical mechanism underlying the therapeutic effects of HS in DKD. In vivo experiments demonstrated that HS treatment inhibited Th17 cell differentiation and downregulated the expression of TGFbeta1, p-SMAD2, and p-SMAD3. Histological analysis via HE staining showed only mild edema in renal tubular epithelial cells following HS treatment. Furthermore, HS treatment improved metabolic abnormalities, such as hyperglycemia and dyslipidemia, as well as renal function markers, including 24-h urinary protein excretion, (Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio)UACR, blood urea nitrogen (BUN) and serum creatinine (Scr) levels. Co-administration of SRI with HS reversed these effects, with metabolic and renal function parameters returning to levels comparable to untreated db/db mice. This suggests that HS mediates its renoprotective effects by inhibiting the TGFbeta signaling pathway, a key target in diabetic nephropathy. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, HS alleviates the progression of DKD by suppressing Th17 cell differentiation through modulation of the TGFbeta/SMAD pathway. This study provides the first evidence of HS as a novel immunomodulatory agent for DKD, highlighting its potential as a promising botanical-based therapeutic strategy for DKD.
abstract_zh: 背景：钩藤碱（Hirsutine, HS）是一种从传统中药钩藤（Uncaria rhynchophylla）中分离出的生物活性吲哚生物碱，长期以来用于治疗高血压和炎症性疾病。然而，其在糖尿病肾病（diabetic kidney disease, DKD）——终末期肾衰竭的主要原因——中的肾脏保护潜力尚未得到充分研究，尤其是其免疫调节机制。材料与方法：对肾组织进行高通量RNA测序以鉴定差异表达基因（differentially expressed genes, DEGs）。采用网络药理学揭示HS在DKD中的潜在靶点及相关通路，同时通过分子对接预测蛋白质相互作用。使用db/db小鼠进行体内验证，给予HS处理，评估肾功能、组织病理学、Th17细胞分化及TGFbeta/SMAD信号通路。结果：转录组分析鉴定出837个DEGs。对这些DEGs的富集分析及网络药理学结果显示，TGFbeta信号介导的Th17细胞分化可能是HS在DKD中治疗效应的关键机制。体内实验表明，HS处理抑制了Th17细胞分化，并下调了TGFbeta1、p-SMAD2和p-SMAD3的表达。HE染色的组织学分析显示，HS处理后肾小管上皮细胞仅出现轻度水肿。此外，HS处理改善了代谢异常，如高血糖和血脂异常，以及肾功能标志物，包括24小时尿蛋白排泄、尿白蛋白肌酐比（UACR）、血尿素氮（BUN）和血清肌酐（Scr）水平。SRI与HS联合给药逆转了这些效应，代谢和肾功能参数恢复到与未处理db/db小鼠相当的水平。这表明HS通过抑制TGFbeta信号通路（糖尿病肾病的关键靶点）介导其肾脏保护作用。结论：总之，HS通过调节TGFbeta/SMAD通路抑制Th17细胞分化，从而缓解DKD的进展。本研究首次提供证据表明HS可作为DKD的新型免疫调节剂，凸显其作为基于植物的DKD治疗策略的潜力。
